During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] maintained a '''fuel refinery''' in the [[Choah Belt/Legends|Choah Belt]]. It was destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Its loss caused critical [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] shortages for Alliance operations in the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]].
